_comment: First install is gated by flashers: only a CandidateScanner that supports a bare board of the type is chosen, in list order; the new-device wait keeps only boards on the scanned port.

mutations.name: only a flasher that can scan is chosen
mutations.find: scanners = [f for f in listed if candidate_scanner(f) is not None]

mutations.name: the chosen flasher must support a bare board of the type
mutations.find:
if flasher.supports(_bare(entry, fw, state), None):
                return FirstInstall(fw, flasher.name, state, None)
mutations.replace:
if True:
                return FirstInstall(fw, flasher.name, state, None)

mutations.name: a scanner is an isinstance check, not every flasher
mutations.find: return flasher if isinstance(flasher, CandidateScanner) else None

mutations.name: the wait keeps only boards on the scanned port
mutations.find:
if port and port_of(paths, dev, inventory) != port:
            continue
